questionText: A router has routes to 10.20.0.0/16 and 10.20.8.0/24. A packet is destined for 10.20.8.45. Which route is selected when both routes are otherwise valid?

answerOptions.text: 10.20.8.0/24 because it is the longest prefix match
The route with the numerically smallest next-hop address
Both routes are used for every packet
